plain_name: brow ridge and eye socket band
purpose: Create a compact human-readable working surface for tuning only the brow ridge and eye sockets against measured skull slice evidence before editing the full head compiler.

region_components.role: Controls the transition from calm forehead plane into the raised brow.
Center brow knot where the brow, nose bridge, and socket shadows meet.
Left supraorbital ridge span and side wrap.
Right supraorbital ridge span and side wrap.
Raised rim that casts the left eye recess.
Raised rim that casts the right eye recess.
Recessed area under the brow; should read as depth, not paint.
Reserved center slot where the later nose wedge emerges from the brow.

skull_evidence_slices.use: Main brow width/depth footprint and upper-orbit band.
Side silhouette for forehead break, brow projection, socket recess, and occiput context.
Front face surface width/height trace for socket placement and brow-to-face relation.
Lower orbit and cheekbone support; used only as the lower boundary for this region.

existing_taxonomy_controls.use: Wrap the brow and upper face around the skull side instead of leaving a flat brow slab.
Shape the brow as a glabella-centered arc instead of a straight strip.
Control almond socket tilt while keeping left and right sockets mirrored.
Reserve and widen the center brow slot where the later nose wedge will land.
Sink brow/socket pieces into the face mask before any join pass.

existing_layer_knobs.use: Socket recess depth under the brow.
Light-catching bevel around each socket rim.

proposed_region_controls.reason: Separate forward projection from vertical brow shape so the brow can be pushed in side view without changing the arc.
Guarantee the socket shadow sits behind the brow instead of on the same flat plane.
Control the center knot between brows and nose bridge independently from the side brow wings.
Let brow wings roll around the side face without forcing the full forehead to wrap equally.

operation_sequence.meaning: Use measured skull slices as evidence only; do not edit geometry yet.
Define the upper plane break before raising the brow.
Build separate glabella and left/right brow wing meshes so the center can project while the wings wrap toward the temples.
Push the sockets behind the brow so they read as shadowed cavities.
Add a small rim bevel so the sockets catch light without becoming decorative eyes.

manual_review_questions: Does the brow read as a continuous supraorbital band rather than a loose plate?
Can the sockets be seen as recesses before any eyeballs are added?
Does the side view show brow projection and socket setback?
Is the glabella center strong enough to receive the future nose bridge?
Do the brow wings wrap toward the sides without turning the whole forehead into a tube?
blocked_scope: Do not tune cheeks except as the lower orbit boundary.
Do not sculpt the nose beyond reserving the bridge landing.
Do not inspect or edit generated full-head blockout output for this review.
Do not join or remesh the head.
